The proof uses correct semilinear product order and never infers infinite claims from finite data.

value.rationale: A natural two-parameter genus-four cyclic trigonal family has a nonreduced multiplicity-two Hasse divisor, but a reduced sixteen-point deeper rank-zero locus with exact Frobenius orbit partition 1,1,2,4,4,4. This is a full motivated arithmetic stratification and distinguishes Cartier rank from stable Frobenius rank; it is not merely a renamed general algorithm or arbitrary isolated computation.
